items.title: India rejects Elon Musk’s claim of discrimination over Starlink launch
items.summary: Starlink is still awaiting security clearance before it can seek spectrum and begin commercial services in India.

items.title: Robot data startup Mecka AI nabs $60M from Sequoia
items.summary: Mecka AI collects and analyzes human motion data to train humanoid robots and other kinds of robots. The startup pays people to record everyday tasks.

items.title: While VCs crowd into San Francisco, Endeavor Catalyst raises $320M for founders ‘elsewhere’
items.summary: Endeavor Catalyst just raised $320 million to keep backing founders outside Silicon Valley. Half the profits go back to the nonprofit that finds them.

items.title: Nous Research confirms it hit $1.5B valuation, launches AI agents for business users
items.summary: The developer of Hermes Agent raised a $90 million Series B.

items.title: Microsoft releases new Nvidia-chip AI PCs with revamped Windows 11
items.summary: Microsoft revealed the specs and price for its Surface Laptop Ultra, AI PCs that run on Nvidia chips that are designed to run AI models and agents.

items.title: Meta’s Muse launches on iPad just a month after its mobile debut
items.summary: Meta’s AI agent Muse is now available on iPad, just a month after its mobile debut, as the company rapidly expands the assistant’s reach and integrations.

items.title: ChatGPT for Teens keeps teens talking, even during mental health crises

items.title: X expands its ‘Gametime’ sports hub beyond the NFL, starting with MLB
items.summary: X is turning its NFL-focused Gametime feature into a year-round sports destination, starting with MLB and with other professional leagues to follow.

items.title: ChatGPT is getting a lot more visual, with the launch of a new interface
items.summary: OpenAI is launching a new user interface that will bring interactive visuals to ChatGPT.

items.title: Greenairy is building smart plant towers to clean the air in your office
items.summary: As it turns out, the cure for stuffy, chemical-infused office air might be a tower of leafy greenery.

items.title: CIA officer admits to creating fake top secret government program to steal over $190M, including gold bars
items.summary: CIA officer David Rush, who worked on highly sensitive intelligence programs, reached a plea deal with U.S. prosecutors after he was caught siphoning money and gold with a fake government contract.

items.title: Meta rolls out new AI tools to detect ads that secretly lead to child sexual abuse material
items.summary: Meta launches new AI tools after discovering ads on its platforms that may look normal but direct users to harmful content elsewhere online.

items.title: Healthleap raises $38M for its AI that flags hospital patients who may need a closer look
items.summary: The financing includes an $8M seed round co-led by Sequoia Capital and First Round Capital, and a $30 million Series A led by Hummingbird Ventures.

items.title: Bloom raises $3.6M to become the ‘Alibaba’ of American manufacturing
items.summary: The Detroit startup has widened its scope beyond mobility to help drone and robotics companies find U.S.-based manufacturers, shippers, and more.

items.title: SpaceX alumni nab $100M to rethink shipping with autonomous freight trains
items.summary: Parallel Systems raised $100 million to scale production of its autonomous electric rail vehicle, which can shuttle thousands of pounds of freight up to 500 miles.

items.title: Tony Fadell on why the first wave of AI gadgets failed — and what comes next
items.summary: The “father of the iPod” says the first generation of AI gadgets failed to solve real problems — and the next wave will need to earn consumers’ trust.

items.title: Google experiments with an AI-powered gaming platform
items.summary: Google Labs is working on a new AI-powered game-creation platform called Playground for users to build browser-based games using simple text prompts.
